prompt: Show that you know which way Function composition runs: implement andThenApply and composeApply, then build a slug maker by chaining trim, lowercase and space-to-dash with andThen.
explanation: Function.andThen(g) reads left to right -- this function first, then g -- while compose(g) reads right to left, running g first, which is why the same pair of functions gives 13 one way and 16 the other. Both return a brand new Function rather than changing either input, so composition is itself a pure operation. Chaining andThen repeatedly builds a whole pipeline as a single value you can name, pass around, and apply later.
hints: Both methods are one line: build the combined function, then call .apply(x) on it.
Remember andThen(g) means "me first, then g"; compose(g) means "g first, then me".
For slug, declare each step as its own Function<String, String> local variable, then join them with .andThen(...).andThen(...).
